name: ascii-button
title: Dither button
description: A button with a lit, dithered surface that brightens on hover and presses in on click, in four fills, two variants and any palette colour.

name: ascii-card
title: Dither card
description: A card with a dithered glow in a corner or along an edge and a dithered rim on its border, which can grow on hover.

name: ascii-fade
title: Dither fade
description: A dithered edge that fades a section's content into a solid colour.

name: ascii-glow
title: Dither glow
description: A soft dithered spotlight from an edge, a corner or any point, for heroes and cards.
